title: Local authorization JWS protected header v1
description: Algorithm is fixed to ES256 for this profile and explicitly typed (RFC 8725 §3.11); any other alg is rejected, never negotiated from the header. Closed schema: 'jwk', 'jku', 'x5u', 'x5c', 'crit' and any key-carrying member are rejected — keys are taken only from the locally trusted store bound to a previously authorized installation (kid → instance). The ES256 signature is the 64-byte R||S concatenation (RFC 7518 §3.4), never ASN.1 DER: PHP openssl_sign/openssl_verify use DER and require conversion; .NET ECDsa defaults to IEEE P1363 (do not use DSASignatureFormat.Rfc3279DerSequence); WebCrypto uses R||S. Header and payload must be parsed with duplicate member names rejected after unescaping (RFC 7493 §2.3).
